title: Ping
subject: Computer Networking
subtitle: Testing Network Connectivity
guiding_question: How can we check whether another device responds across a network?
description: A network diagnostic utility used to test whether a destination can be reached across an IP network and to measure round-trip time.

learning_objectives.text: Explain what Ping is and why it is used.
Describe how an ICMP Echo Request and Echo Reply work.
Interpret basic Ping results and round-trip time.
